Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM is looking for an Account Director to own and build TRM's footprint across US Federal Offices of Inspector General (OIGs), with the primary responsibility of bringing Ardence, TRM's AI investigation platform for all-source intelligence, to the investigators and analysts who uncover fraud.

This is a high-trust, territory-owner role for a self-starting seller who knows how OIGs operate, can independently build pipeline, and run federal sales cycles.

The impact you will have:

  • Serve as the trusted point of contact between TRM and OIG investigators, analysts, agency leadership, and contracting officers.

  • Own and build the OIG territory. Map and tier target OIGs within 30 days and stand up 3x pipeline coverage within 90 days.

  • Position Ardence as a mission-critical platform for OIG investigations, helping teams pull together all-source intelligence and examine their findings.

  • Bring Solutions Architects, Global Investigators, Compliance Advisory, and Policy colleagues into the right conversations at the right time.

  • Run end-to-end federal sales cycles: discovery, technical evaluation, procurement, and close. Navigate federal buying vehicles and agency purchasing rules without hand-holding.

  • Use AI as the default first move across the workflow: Claude and ChatGPT for prospecting, account research, and outbound. Aim to free 4 to 10 hours a week of admin time and redirect it to customer engagement.

What we're looking for:

  • Direct experience working with or inside a federal Office of Inspector General strongly preferred; state-level OIG experience is also valued. You understand how OIGs investigate, buy, and make decisions.

  • 3+ years of sales experience selling software or technology into government, with a record of consistent quota attainment.

  • Working familiarity with federal procurement vehicles and FAR-based contracting, including GSA Schedules, BPAs, IDIQs, SEWP, and GWACs.

  • A go-getter mindset and a proven track record of self-generated pipeline. This is a territory-ownership role, not a lead-harvesting role.

  • Strong executive presence and excellent consultative selling skills: listening first, proposing second, and always tying back to the agency's mission.

  • Demonstrated AI fluency. Comfortable using AI tools daily across prospecting, account research, outbound, and reporting.

  • Based in the Washington, DC metro area highly preferred, with willingness to travel to agency sites, conferences, and trainings.

  • Active US Government Security Clearance or clearance eligibility is a plus.

  • Experience with investigative, intelligence, OSINT, or case-management software is a plus. Crypto or blockchain knowledge is not required.

  • This position requires US Citizenship.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Block is seeking a Compliance Technology Program Lead to ensure our Machine Learning and Heuristic detection models — and the data infrastructure that feeds them — are fit for purpose, for our fiat and virtual currency products. This role sits at the intersection of compliance, machine learning, and AI tooling: you will use modern intelligence tools, including Claude and other LLM-based agents, to automate significant portions of oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — turning a traditionally manual, documentation-heavy function into a scalable, defensible program. You will partner with Machine Learning, Engineering and BSA/AML Policy Teams to provide end-to-end technical oversight, effective challenge and ongoing monitoring throughout the model development lifecycle.

You Will

  • Build with Modern AI Tools: Use AI agents (Claude and similar LLM-based tools) to build automation that scales oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — including drafting requirements, exam-ready documentation, data quality monitoring and ongoing model performance reporting.
  • Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints so that automated outputs remain defensible to regulators and independent monitors.
  • Establish and maintain model and data governance frameworks aligned with SR 11-7, SR 26-2, and OCC 2011-12 so engineering teams can ship defensible models at pace. Provide effective challenge throughout the model development lifecycle and partner with the BSA/AML Policy Team and CAX stakeholders to ensure documentation is exam-ready.
  • Lead Ongoing Monitoring: Lead the design and development of real-time dashboards to monitor model health, including input data monitoring and ongoing model performance.
  • Set standards for threshold tuning and ongoing Below the Line (BTL) testing controls.
  • Establish frameworks and triggers for identifying when model performance is degrading and requires tuning or deprecation. Partner during subsequent tuning exercises and ensure changes are within risk appetite and documented defensibly.
  • Provide End-to-End Oversight of Model Development: Oversee Transaction Monitoring models, including heuristic and rules-based detection logic, threshold settings (below the line testing), and the data pipelines that feed alerts.
  • Oversee blockchain analytics and screening tools (TRM, Chainalysis), with attention to typology coverage, alert quality, and integration with downstream investigations.
  • Oversee Sanctions Screening models (LexisNexis), including list management, fuzzy-match tuning, and false-positive reduction.
  • Oversee Customer Risk Scoring models, including segmentation logic, periodic recalibration, and effective challenge of risk drivers.
  • Oversee the design and validation of AI-driven case resolution — LLM-based and ML-based models that triage, enrich, or disposition alerts — ensuring decisions are explainable, auditable, and defensible to regulators.

You Have

  • 7+ years of experience in compliance technology at regulated financial institutions, or as a consultant working with FIs.
  • Hands-on experience building with modern AI tools — including Claude, GPT, or comparable LLM-based agents — and a track record of using them to automate work in production. This includes prompt engineering, designing agentic workflows, and integrating AI into operational processes.
  • Experience with both Machine Learning and Heuristic models across Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, and Customer Risk Scoring.
  • Experience with input data quality monitoring.
  • Experience with model performance monitoring.
  • Experience conducting AML model validations aligned with SR 11-7 and OCC 2011-12.
  • Experience responding to examinations and consent orders, and working with regulators and independent monitors.
  • Experience with virtual currencies, including the unique transaction monitoring and sanctions screening considerations they present.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics and screening tools such as Chainalysis and TRM Labs.
  • A track record of driving cross-functional initiatives.
  • A working understanding of regulated financial services and corresponding compliance obligations.
  • Familiarity with statistical concepts related to machine learning
  • Expertise in data analytics and visualization

About Aspora

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.

Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.

We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.

About the Role

People build lives across borders, and their finances should move with them. We’re building Aspora for the global diaspora, starting with Indians abroad. Regulation sits at the centre of that ambition. This role exists to turn a complex set of requirements into a practical way to build and run the business. One global framework, local differences only where the law needs them, and decisions made by clear frameworks rather than daily escalations.

You’ll lead licensing, regulator engagement, product advice, safeguarding oversight, customer protection and operational resilience. You’ll report to our COO, working alongside our Global MLRO. You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance and local compliance owners to turn requirements into working controls. You’ll own the regulatory calls on launches, changes and the commitments we make to regulators.

Who You Are

You don’t see regulation as a reason to say no, or as something to work around. You know a hard boundary from a choice, and your depth goes well beyond AML or licensing paperwork.

  • You’ve scaled fintechs before. You’ve helped a payments, remittance or e-money business grow, in house or as a consultant, and can show what you changed.

  • You turn expertise into execution. You’ve translated payments and e-money requirements into customer journeys, controls and processes, with fewer failures and less friction to show for it.

  • You get permissions over the line. You’ve owned licensing or variation work and regulatory reporting, and kept applications, governance and operating reality consistent throughout.

  • You speak regulator fluently, and you’ve been tested. You’ve handled supervisory questions, inspections or a hard remediation, made sound calls under pressure and stayed until it was fixed.

  • You’ve set standards at HQ level. You’ve built shared standards across markets and distributed teams, and you know where local law needs a difference and where duplication is habit.

  • You’ve seen controls work in practice. You go deep on UK payments, e-money, safeguarding and customer protection, and you’ve followed gaps through to a verified fix.

  • You’re on the way up. Your career shows quick progression, growing ownership and real depth. We’ll judge the work you’ve done, not the title you hold.

Most importantly, you want to build a global regulatory framework from the ground up and see it work in practice.

What You’ll Own

This is a role with a genuinely global mandate, with UK payments and e-money regulation as the depth anchor.

  • Own licensing and regulator engagement. Lead permissions, perimeter analysis, applications and variations, with accurate filings and a clear register of every commitment we make.

  • Shape products before they launch. Assess launches and changes against UK PSRs, EMRs and FCA rules, and turn horizon scanning into owned implementation plans.

  • Hold safeguarding to a high standard. Challenge the design, test the evidence and keep us audit ready, partnering with Finance on reconciliations and governance.

  • Make customer protection measurable. Drive Consumer Duty, fair value, vulnerable customers, complaints and partner oversight, using outcome data to spot harm and assign action.

  • Own the regulatory view on resilience. Partner with operations and technology owners on service mapping, testing and outsourcing oversight, and own the incident reporting decisions.

  • Build one global framework. Set shared standards across markets, add local differences only where law requires them, and bring in local expertise where it’s needed.

What you build here will shape where Aspora can launch, how quickly we get there, and how much regulators trust us along the way.

Why Aspora

  • Define the global regulatory compliance framework for a borderless financial platform, from first principles.

  • Work directly with our COO and Global MLRO, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance and Operations.

  • Set the standard for how a regulated fintech scales across multiple jurisdictions without losing pace.

  • Own licensing, product advice, safeguarding oversight and customer protection from day one, not a narrow slice of compliance.

  • Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora’s long-term vision.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Tax team's mission is to proactively manage our global tax footprint while supporting Robinhood’s mission to democratize finance for all! We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Finance teams to navigate complex tax regulations and enable business growth. Our team values deep collaboration, technical excellence, and proactive problem-solving. We maintain a high-performing, supportive culture where every team member is encouraged to challenge the status quo.

As the Manager, Global Indirect Tax, you will lead our global indirect tax compliance, controversy, transaction advisory, and operations initiatives.  
You will manage end-to-end global indirect tax operations, including compliance, audits, system improvements, and technical research and advisory. You will play a critical role in shaping our overall indirect tax strategy and compliance framework for innovative products and business models. This is a unique opportunity to build scalable tax processes in a fast-growing financial services environment, spearheading the next generation of tax operations through automation and AI-enabled solutions.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Oversee global indirect tax operations, including VAT, GST, sales and use tax, and other non-income transactional tax compliance, registrations, return filings, and payment processes across relevant jurisdictions
  • Manage indirect tax audits and notices, acting as the primary point of contact for tax authorities to resolve assessments and disputes
  • Provide clear technical tax advice regarding indirect tax implications for new products, acquisitions, contracts, cross-border transactions, and business reorganizations
  • Partner cross-functionally to support taxability determinations, invoicing requirements, exemption documentation, and implementation of indirect tax requirements or process improvements in systems and operational processes
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments affecting global indirect tax and translate those developments into practical guidance, risk mitigation, and process updates

What you bring

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 8+ years of tax experience, including substantial indirect tax experience within a multinational corporate environment
  • Hands-on experience with global indirect tax compliance, audits, and operational support across multiple jurisdictions, including successful resolution of controversy matters with tax authorities
  • A proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and developing a team of tax professionals
  • Proficiency in analyzing financial data and working with corporate tax systems or tax determination software; experience driving automation initiatives to improve process efficiency is preferred
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, changing work environment and are able to manage competing priorities with sound judgment and strong execution 

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Electrical SME is Managed Services' electrical expert embedded in a data center build - supporting design review and commissioning witness to ensure electrical systems are operable and maintainable at turnover. The electrical system is the facility's spine; this role makes sure it can be operated, switched, and maintained safely by the team inheriting it.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:


Operability Design Review

Review electrical designs - MV/LV distribution, generator plants, UPS systems, EPMS - for operability: maintenance access and working clearances, switching practicality and arc-flash exposure during real operating procedures, redundancy behavior under maintenance conditions, and labeling/mimic clarity. Push back where the design assumes maintenance that can't safely be performed.

Construction - Phase Verification

Walk electrical installations at key milestones: equipment setting and clearances, terminations and torque documentation, grounding, and cable management quality - flagging operability and quality issues to the MEP superintendent early.

Testing & Commissioning Witness

Witness NETA acceptance testing and Level 3-5 commissioning: protective device testing, generator and UPS transfer sequences, load bank testing, pull-the-plug scenarios, and integrated systems testing. Drive operational findings into the Cx log and verify closure.

Turnover Readiness

Verify electrical turnover packages: test records and settings files, one-lines and as-builts, arc-flash labels matching final studies, spare breakers and critical spares, PM program inputs, and switching procedures. Confirm operator training covers real switching and emergency scenarios.

Energization & Early Operations

Support energization sequences and early operations stabilization: alarm and EPMS tuning input, operating procedure refinement, and first-months troubleshooting with the operations team.

Program Feedback

Feed operational lessons into Hut 8 electrical standards and future basis-of-design decisions.

ABOUT YOU

-      What we're looking for:

  • 8+ years in critical facilities electrical operations, commissioning, or NETA-adjacent field roles.
  • Deep knowledge of MV/LV switchgear, protective devices, generator and UPS systems, and EPMS/power monitoring.

  • Maintainability instincts in design review: clearances, access, and safe isolation paths.
